subject: Mystic Avenue Corridor Rezoning
overview: The Council granted final approval for the Mystic Avenue Corridor District zoning and approved first readings for the Welcoming City and public surveillance ordinances. The body also authorized a $5 million school HVAC loan and requested several reports from the administration concerning employee drug testing and municipal financial reporting.

items.title: Resolution Recognizing Barbara Kerr
items.summary: The Council commended Barbara Kerr for 40 years of service at the Medford Public Library and invited her to receive a formal citation in the new year.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved meeting records from November 26, 2024, and December 3, 2024.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Reports were approved from the Planning and Permitting, Governance, and Resident Services committees regarding zoning, charter review, and resident engagement.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Loan Order
items.summary: The Council ordained a loan order for the Riverside Plaza project on third reading.

items.title: School HVAC and Roof Infrastructure Loan
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of a $5 million loan order for repairs at the Andrews and McGlynn schools and scheduled a Committee of the Whole for early January to review the full $25 million project scope.

items.title: Lead Line Replacement Funding
items.summary: An appropriation of $100,000 from the water and sewer capital stabilization fund was approved for the lead line replacement rebate program.

items.title: Municipal Accountability and Employee Policy Resolutions
items.summary: The Council rejected a request for information on the school superintendent's contract but approved requests for administrative reports on the city's bond rating, private investigator usage, and drug testing policies following reports of mass testing at the DPW.

items.title: Medford Fire Department Consultant Report Update
items.summary: The Council requested an update on the fire department consultant report and a future committee meeting to review its findings with union leadership.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Corridor District Zoning
items.summary: The Council granted final approval to the Mystic Avenue Corridor District zoning following a public hearing, incorporating amendments related to affordable housing incentives and ground-floor commercial requirements.

items.title: Meadow Glen Signage Special Permit
items.summary: The Council continued the public hearing on a special permit for signs at the Meadow Glen mall to the next regular meeting.

items.title: Mrs. Murphy's Common Victualler's License
items.summary: A common victualler's license was approved for Mrs. Murphy's pub in Medford Square.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of the Welcoming City Ordinance, which codifies policies restricting local law enforcement cooperation with federal immigration agencies for civil enforcement.

items.title: Amendments to Public Surveillance Ordinance (CCOPS)
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of amendments to the surveillance ordinance to strengthen data deletion requirements and restrict the purchase of commercially available bulk surveillance data.

items.title: Tufts University Dormitory Project Resolution
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting that Tufts University reduce the height of its proposed 401 Boston Avenue dormitory and drop its opposition to state institutional master plan and PILOT legislation.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Referral
items.summary: The proposed Salem Street Corridor District zoning was referred to the Community Development Board for its required public hearing.
